Market today:
The market's feeling a bit on edge, mainly driven by the looming Fed rate decision and potential surprises there. Plus, news around AI leadership and big tech consolidation could stir things up for your tech and chip-heavy book.

Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on any Fed commentary leading up to the October meeting. Also, monitor developments in the AI sector, as that's a core part of your portfolio's exposure.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your downside risk, especially on those leveraged positions that are already deep in the red and below their stops.
plays: Seriously consider trimming SOXL, MUU, SMCI, and SPAL. All are below their stops, and the leveraged ones are amplifying significant losses on margin.
